sources.intro: Oil paintings, larger canvases, architectural heat studies, portraits where identifiable, and other studio works.
Watercolours, paper works, systems images and portrait material where identifiable.
Drawings, studies, portraits where identifiable, botanical observations and coastal works on paper.
Studio experiments, colour tests, digital processes and unresolved visual research.
Maps, field layouts and spatial images where environmental evidence becomes visual structure.

Portrait classification is heuristic until manually curated.
